ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) base pigmentation to high-intensity (white/gray) surface markings and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white punctate mottling clustered heavily on the distal tips of both lobes; large contiguous dark regions occupying the proximal center; extensive white linear markings cross-hatching the central and right-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 32 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-frequency jagged serrations; notable deep macro-notches (voids) located on the inner margin of the left lobe and middle margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges sweeping upward to acute, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white pixel groups concentrated at the outer extremities (tips) of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) most prominent in the dark central and right-medial sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular jagged notches and tissue loss along the trailing edge of both lobes; heavy rake mark scarring across the central dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific cross-hatched scarring pattern ('X' shape) visible on the right-central lobe area.
